build_lm1b_dataset: build the Lm1b dataset builder using tfds.builder_cls('lm1b') to access the Language Model 1B benchmark
create_lm1b_builder: create an Lm1b dataset builder instance with tfds.core.GeneratorBasedBuilder for 1 billion word language modeling
test_lm1b_splits: test the Lm1b dataset builder to generate train and test splits from tokenized news data
review_lm1b_info: review the Lm1b dataset builder _info method to inspect features and supervised_keys configuration
summarize_lm1b_download: summarize how the Lm1b builder downloads and extracts the 1B word benchmark from statmt.org
